description: Apply to one job only after the member approves that named job, current profile, truthful automatic answers and tailored documents. Requires job_approved true and a stable idempotency_key. With this assistant’s hosted standing send grant, queues one application for one credit; otherwise holds without employer contact or charge and returns the approval and grant URLs. Never accepts screening answers. Reuse the same key when retrying the same request.

idempotency_key.description: A stable unique key for this exact job and resume selection. Reuse on retries.

job_approved.description: Must be true after explicit approval of this named job and application scope.

resume_source.description: Choose the current uploaded CV instead of a later changed default resume.

resume_variant_id.description: Optional owned resume from get_profile; otherwise your chosen application resume.
